Firefox can remember what you've entered in forms on web pages, also known as text fields. After you've entered something into a form on a web page (such as a search box), the next time you visit that page, your previous entry will be available to re-use. This article describes how to use the auto form fill feature and how to clear or prevent it from storing form entries.

__TOC__

= Using Auto Form Fill =
To use your previous entry in a form:
# Type the first few letters of the entry into the form field. Firefox will display a drop-down menu with what you've typed into the form before.
#* You may see a list of all the entries stored for a particular form field by pressing the {key &#8595;} key when the field is empty.
# Press the {key &#8595;} key to select the entry you want to re-use. Press {for win,linux}{key Enter}{/for}{for mac}{key Return}{/for} when the appropriate entry is highlighted. The text of the entry will appear in the form field. You may also use the mouse to click on the entry.

= Deleting individual form entries =
If you want to remove one of your previous form entries from Firefox's history:
# Click on the form field and press the {key &#8595;} key to display all the saved entries. You may type the first few letters of the entry to limit the number of entries displayed.
# Use the {key &#8595;} key or the mouse pointer to highlight the entry you wish to delete.
# Press {for mac}{key Shift}+{/for}{key Delete}. The entry will be removed.
Repeat the process for each entry that you'd like to delete.

= Clearing form history =
If you want Firefox to forget all of your previous form entries:
# [[Template:fx29menu]]
# Click {menu History}, and then click {menu Clear recent history…}
# In the ''When:'' drop-down, choose {menu Everything}.
# Make sure that '''Saved form info''' has a check mark next to it.
# Click {button Clear Now} to clear your form history and close the dialog box.

= Turn off Auto form fill and prevent Firefox from storing more form entries =
If you don't want Firefox to remember what you've entered into form fields, you can turn off the auto form fill feature:
{for not fx152}
# [[T:optionspreferences]]
# [[Template:customhistory]]
# Remove the check mark next to '''Remember search and form history'''.
# [[T:closeOptionsPreferences]]
{/for}
{for fx152}
# [[T:optionspreferences]]
# [[Template:customhistory]]
#;[[Image:Fx152settings-CustomizeHistory]]
# Under ''Advanced settings'', remove the check mark next to '''Remember search and form history'''.
{/for}
Disabling form history also prevents Firefox from storing search history for the [[Clear recent searches from the Search bar|Search bar]] in the Navigation Toolbar.
{note}'''Address Autofill:''' To turn off address autofill, see [[Automatically fill in your address on web forms]].{/note}

= Troubleshooting =
If you find that Firefox does not save your form entries and you cannot re-use them, please read the article [[Firefox doesn't save web form entries]].
